verdict.rationale: Auth0 is a SaaS identity platform, so a built-in AI assistant in its dashboard or console is a fair question. The evidence does not show one. The MCP server lets external AI tools such as Claude Desktop, Cursor or Windsurf manage a tenant, and Agent Skills and CLI Agent Mode serve outside agents. Those are integrations for third-party assistants, not an assistant built into Auth0, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
